name: looksmatter-backend
description: LOOKSMATTER commerce backend as microservices: API gateway, core service and order service

scripts.install:services: npm ci --prefix gateway && npm ci --prefix services/core-service && npm ci --prefix services/order-service
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n gateway,core,orders -c cyan,green,magenta "npm start --prefix gateway" "npm start --prefix services/core-service" "npm start --prefix services/order-service"
